items.question: What is the cash threshold in AED above which passengers entering or leaving the UAE must declare money to ICP?
items.gold: Passengers must declare cash over AED 60,000 (or equivalent in other currencies) to ICP.
items.fact: Money declaration required above AED 60,000 cash to ICP.

items.question: What is the maximum total value of gifts, perfumes and personal luggage that passengers can bring into the UAE exempt from customs fees?
items.fact: Personal belongings exempt from customs fees up to AED 3,000.
